title: 客服工单升级与 SLA 合规

sources.title: Atlassian Service Level Agreement (Cloud Products)
sources.key_facts: Premium plan: 99.90% uptime; Enterprise plan: 99.95% uptime. Credit tiers — Premium: 10% (99.0–99.9%), 25% (95.0–99.0%), 50% (<95.0%); Enterprise: 5% (99.90–99.95%), 10% (99.0–99.9%), 25% (95.0–99.0%), 50% (<95.0%). Downtime Minute defined as error rate >5% in a given minute. Credit claim deadline: 15 days after end of calendar month.

sources.title: Atlassian Support Offerings — Severity Levels and Response Times
sources.key_facts: 5-tier severity: L1 (Production down), L2 (Serious degradation), L3 (Moderate impact), L4 (Limited impact), L5-BETA (How-to). Enterprise plan response times: L1=30min (24/7), L2=2h (24/7), L3=8h (weekdays), L4=24h (weekdays). Premium plan: L1=1h (24/7), L2=2h (24/5). Standard plan: L1=2 business hours (9/5), L2=6 business hours.

sources.title: AWS Support Plan Comparison — Response Times by Severity
sources.key_facts: Five severity levels: General guidance (<24h), System impaired (<12h), Production system impaired (<4h), Production system down (<1h), Business-critical system down. Enterprise: <15min for critical; Business+: <30min for critical; Unified Operations: <5min for critical (from Incident Management Engineer).

sources.title: AWS Support API Reference — SeverityLevel
sources.key_facts: Code-to-name mapping: low=General guidance, normal=System impaired, high=Production system impaired, urgent=Production system down, critical=Business-critical system down. Valid code values: low | normal | high | urgent | critical.

sources.title: Amazon EC2 Service Level Agreement
sources.key_facts: Region-Level SLA: 99.99% monthly uptime (multi-AZ). Instance-Level SLA: 99.5%. Credit tiers (both levels): 10% (99.0–99.99%), 30% (95.0–99.0%), 100% (<95.0%). Automatic credit trigger: instance unavailable >6 minutes within a clock hour (no claim needed). Claim deadline: end of second billing cycle after incident.

sources.title: AWS Lambda Service Level Agreement
sources.key_facts: Monthly uptime commitment: 99.95% per region. Credit tiers: 10% (99.0–99.95%), 25% (95.0–99.0%), 100% (<95.0%). Availability measured per 5-minute interval. Error defined as 500 or 503 status codes (excluding custom status codes generated by function code). Minimum credit balance: $1 USD.

sources.title: Google Cloud Platform — Technical Support Services Guidelines
sources.key_facts: Priority definitions: P0 (Mission Critical Services environments), P1 (Critical Impact — Service Unusable in Production), P2 (High Impact — Severely Impaired), P3 (Medium Impact — Partially Impaired), P4 (Low Impact — Fully Usable). Premium support response times: P1=15min, P2=2h, P3=4h, P4=8h. Standard support: P2=4h, P3=8h, P4=8h (P1 not supported). Google may reclassify priority; P1 requires continuous customer availability.

sources.title: Salesforce — Severity Level Descriptions for Support Cases
sources.key_facts: 4 severity levels: L1-Critical (Business stopping, no workaround / imminent financial risk), L2-Urgent (Key business impacting, no workaround), L3-High (Key business impacting with workaround, OR non-key no workaround), L4-Medium (Non-key with workaround, OR not business impacting). No response time targets specified in the document.
